info.name: BiblePlus API — Full Collection (QA/UAT + all endpoints)
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for the BiblePlus backend.

**Folders 00-12** are the QA/UAT regression suite — requests named REGRESSION pin a
specific bug that was fixed; if one fails, the bug is back.

**Folders 13-24** cover the rest of the API surface (auth, profile, bible, reader
features, prayer, quiz gameplay, chatbot, and the remaining admin screens) with
smoke assertions: route exists, and no 5xx.

## Two identities
- `adminToken` — captured by **00 · Setup → Admin login**
- `userToken`  — captured by **13 · Auth → Login**

Run `00 · Setup` then `13 · Auth` before anything else, or just run the whole
collection in order.

## Notes
- OTP is email-only in every environment; there is no bypass code. `13 · Auth → Verify OTP`
  and the two password-reset requests are MANUAL: read the code from the inbox into the
  `emailOtp` (or `adminOtp`) variable before sending. Codes expire in 5 minutes (admin: 10).
- Requests whose description says ATTACH AN IMAGE need a file before they will pass.
- `14 · Profile → Delete my account` is destructive; skip unless intended.
- Point `baseUrl` at staging, not production — several folders create and delete data.

request.description: Issues a new OTP and invalidates any outstanding one. Needed because the emailed code is now the only way to verify — if the first mail never arrived, this is the recovery path. Returns 502 if the email itself could not be sent, rather than falsely reporting success.

exec: console.warn("Set the emailOtp variable to the code from the email before running this.");

request.description:
MANUAL STEP. Read the 6-digit code from the inbox for {{testEmail}} and put it in the `emailOtp` collection variable, then send.

There is no bypass code in any environment — the emailed OTP is the only credential accepted. The field name is `otp` (not `code`).

The OTP expires 5 minutes after it is issued; if it lapses, run 'Resend verification OTP' first.
